_comment: GENERATED by dos_port/tools/sm83xlat/build_symbols.py. Matched on NORMALIZED NAME against pret ram/*.asm labels, with the address as an independent cross-check. Review `ambiguous` and `addr_conflict` by hand before renaming anything.

W_FONT_LOADED.comment: wFontLoaded (bit BIT_FONT_LOADED set while text font is in VRAM)

W_GRASS_TILE.comment: wGrassTile (tile ID treated as tall grass; $ff = none)

W_JOY_IGNORE.comment: wJoyIgnore — button mask; bits set suppress those inputs

W_MON_H_GROWTH_RATE.comment: sym-verified (wMonHeader $D0B7 + BASE_GROWTH_RATE $13). A prior pass wrongly "corrected" this to $D0CB on the false premise that wMonHeader was $D0B8; the symbols-branch pokeyellow.sym puts wMonHGrowthRate at $D0CA. experience.asm (CalcExperience) consumes it; was masked by the self-contained native harness.

H_JOY6.comment: hJoy6 — low-sens flag: 0 = suppress repeat while A/B held

H_JOY7.comment: hJoy7 — low-sens flag: 0 = newly-pressed only, 1 = held+delay

H_JOY_PRESSED.comment: hJoyPressed — buttons just pressed this frame

H_MAP_STRIDE.comment: hMapStride (= map block row stride = width + 2*MAP_BORDER)

H_MAP_WIDTH.comment: hMapWidth (= wCurMapWidth, stored for row-copy inner loop)

H_PIKACHU_SPRITE_VRAM_OFFSET.comment: hPikachuSpriteVRAMOffset (added to tile id $80+; 0 for now)

H_SPRITE_OFFSET2.comment: hSpriteOffset2 (current slot offset in PrepareOAMData loop)

W_CUR_MAP_HEADER.comment: wCurMapHeader (start of fixed header copy target)

W_MAP_VIEW_VRAM_POINTER.comment: wMapViewVRAMPointer (Stage A Note: dropped/unused after native renderer)

W_NPC_MOVEMENT_DIRECTIONS.comment: wNPCMovementDirections (union base; sim-joypad end/dirs2 overlay it)

W_PLAYER_LAST_STOP_DIRECTION.comment: wPlayerLastStopDirection (dir held when player last stopped)

W_SIMULATED_JOYPAD_STATES_END.comment: wSimulatedJoypadStatesEnd — PAD_* byte queued by scripts

ARROW_OFF_FRAMES.comment: frames ▼ stays hidden   (0.13 s at 60 Hz)

ARROW_ON_FRAMES.comment: frames ▼ stays visible  (0.5 s at 60 Hz)

BIT_BATTLE_OVER_OR_BLACKOUT.comment: wStatusFlags4 bit 5 — set on battle/blackout return

BIT_DUNGEON_WARP.comment: wStatusFlags6 bit 4 — entered via dungeon warp

BIT_ESCAPE_WARP.comment: wStatusFlags6 bit 6 — Escape Rope / blackout warp

BIT_EXITING_DOOR.comment: set by PlayerStepOutFromDoor (door tile); player is auto-walking off door

BIT_FLY_OR_DUNGEON_WARP.comment: wStatusFlags6 bit 2 — entered via Fly OR dungeon warp

BIT_FLY_WARP.comment: wStatusFlags6 bit 3 — entered via Fly warp (dup: items/town_map.asm)

BIT_NO_MAP_MUSIC.comment: wStatusFlags7 bit 1 — suppress this map's default music

BIT_NO_MENU_BUTTON_SOUND.comment: wMiscFlags bit — suppress the menu A-press SFX

BIT_NO_NPC_FACE_PLAYER.comment: wStatusFlags3 bit 5 — suppress NPC-face-player on this entry

BIT_NO_PREVIOUS_MAP.comment: wCurMapTileset bit 7 (constants/ram_constants.asm) — set by save-load, LoadMapHeader res's it

BIT_PUSHED_BOULDER.comment: a boulder was pushed this frame

BIT_SCRIPTED_MOVEMENT_STATE.comment: simulated joypad active (door exit / scripted walk)

BIT_SCRIPTED_NPC_MOVEMENT.comment: wStatusFlags5 bit — MoveSprite scripted NPC walk

BIT_SPRITE_UNDER_GRASS.comment: tile drawn with BG priority when in grass

BIT_STANDING_ON_DOOR.comment: set by warp arrival; triggers auto-walk-off

BIT_STANDING_ON_WARP.comment: edge-detect: 1 = player was on a warp tile last step

BIT_TALKED_TO_TRAINER.comment: wStatusFlags3 bit 6 — talked to a trainer this encounter (OW-A.6)

BIT_TEXT_DELAY.comment: 1=delay enabled; TextCommandProcessor sets this per session

BIT_TRAINER_BATTLE.comment: wStatusFlags7 bit 3 — current battle is a trainer battle (OW-A.6)

BIT_TRIED_PUSH_BOULDER.comment: player has tried pushing once (needs twice)

BIT_TURNING.comment: wMiscFlags bit — player is turning in place this frame (constants/ram_constants.asm)

BIT_USING_GENERIC_PC.comment: wMiscFlags bit — HoF/Bill's/generic PC hosts the menu (S6 pkg F)

BIT_WILD_ENCOUNTER_COOLDOWN.comment: wStatusFlags2 bit 0 — grants 3 no-battle steps (dup: gb_constants.inc)

B_OAM_PAL1.comment: bit position of the OBP select bit

CONN_STRIP_SRC.comment: ConnectionStripSrc  (dw) — src in connected map's blocks

FACING_END.comment: $01 — last OAM entry of a facing block

H_DOWN_ARROW_COUNT2.comment: hDownArrowBlinkCount2 — compat; 1 in 60 Hz blink mode

IO_LY.comment: rLY   — TODO-HW: renderer emulates scanline counter

IO_STAT.comment: rSTAT — TODO-HW: renderer writes mode bits

MAP_BORDER.comment: block-unit border around map in wOverworldMap

MAP_NO_CONNECTION.comment: sentinel: no connected map in this direction

MAP_TILESET_SIZE.comment: tile IDs >= $60 are text-box tiles, not map tiles

OAM_X_OFS.comment: subtract to get real screen X

OAM_Y_OFS.comment: subtract to get real screen Y

RENDER_H.comment: back buffer / VGA height in pixels

RENDER_W.comment: back buffer / VGA width in pixels

SCREEN_TILES_H.comment: viewport height in tiles (= RENDER_H / TILE_HEIGHT)

SCREEN_TILES_W.comment: viewport width in tiles (= RENDER_W / TILE_WIDTH)

SOUND_MASK.comment: wOptions bits 4-5 = sound/earphone setting (S6 pkg D)

SPRITESTATEDATA2_ISTRAINER.comment: port istrainer flag (DIVERGENCE: pret has no such field);

SPRITESTATEDATA2_MOVEMENTDELAY.comment: frames until next random walk attempt (pret 0x08)

SPRITESTATEDATA2_ORIGFACINGDIRECTION.comment: pret ORIGFACINGDIRECTION (OW-A.2 restores; was bespoke ISTRAINER)

SPRITE_PIKACHU.comment: pret constants/sprite_constants.asm (loaded separately in each set)

TEXT_DELAY_MASK.comment: bits 3-0 of wOptions hold text speed

VGA_FRAMEBUF.comment: linear address of VGA framebuffer (flat DS)

WIN_CLIP_W.comment: dd: visible width in px (cols blitted from row_buf)

WIN_MAX_Y.comment: dd: first screen row the box stops drawing at (exclusive)

WIN_START_ROW.comment: dd: tilemap row that WLY=0 maps to (the box's first src row)

WIN_WX.comment: dd: window left edge in WX units (screen-left col = WX-7)

WIN_WY.comment: dd: window top edge (screen-Y px); >= RENDER_H hides it

W_D433.comment: wd433 — Pikachu collision direction (set by sprite collision engine)

W_INTRO_SPAWN_DATA_SIZE.comment: staged image ends 0xF991, inside the 0x2A0 reservation

W_TILESET_HEADER_COPY_SIZE.comment: bytes copied from tileset header to wTilesetBank

W_TILESET_HEADER_FULL_SIZE.comment: full tileset header entry size (11 + animations)
